scope: Development comparison slice, not a complete M1 or final quality gate. All three declared seeds participate. Missing seeds prevent comparison; failures rank after finite scores.

cases.construction: Five open-top finger-jointed panels per box. Closed contours in each source part group define outer boundary and holes; burn=0, no labels/reference.

Original 10 mm seam allowance cut paths at full precision. On-fold parts unfolded at X=0; each cut-two part has explicit left/right contours. Grain parallel to Y, rotations 0/180, no placement reflection. Finite 1500 mm wide roll sections.
